summary: Primary evidence for a differential NUDT5/NUDT14 causal-selectivity panel.

actual_web_queries: Page 2018 NUDT5 TH5427 targeted NUDT5 inhibitors block hormone signaling breast cancer
inspected: Page2018 full-text XML, selected structural/selectivity/biological Methods and Results; selected SI figure captions and TH5427/TH1713 synthesis
Balikci2024 full-text XML, Table 1 image, existing source CSV, selected SI captions and Table S2
Five RCSB entry and polymer records, six assembly records, five mmCIF files and four CCD records
not_searched_or_performed: Independent read of Wright nuclear-ATP primary work cited by Page
Docking, MD or new contact calculations
Wet-lab experiments, cell tests or clinical evaluation
actions_not_taken: No repository modification, commit, push or PR
scope.novelty_limit: A constructive direction for this project; not a claim of literature priority. Existing Balikci data are not newly discovered training data.

claims.claim: 5NWH contains TH5427/9CH at 2.6 A; 5NQR contains TH1713/958 at 2.2 A.
9CH has formula C20 H20 Cl2 N8 O3 and a 1,3-dimethyl xanthine core; 958 is a different ligand.
claims.inspected_location: CCD chem_comp/descriptors; Page SI TH5427/TH1713 synthetic identities
claims.limits: Repository reference graph not inspected or changed.

claims.claim: 8RDZ is 2.02 A, ligand A1H14; 8RIY is 2.288 A and 8OTV 1.82 A, both ligand W0O.
claims.inspected_location: B Figs.1/3/4 and SI Table S2; current deposits
claims.limits: Rounded article resolutions distinguished from precise deposit values.

claims.claim: The five structures are human proteins expressed in E. coli; deposited assemblies are dimers. 8RDZ ASU has four chains but assemblies A/C and B/D.
claims.inspected_location: Entity/assembly API for all five deposits; full source_manifest.json
claims.limits: Deposited assembly annotations do not by themselves establish solution oligomer equilibria.

claims.claim: ASU modeled Mg counts 5NWH/5NQR/8RDZ/8RIY/8OTV are 0/0/8/0/1; unmodeled-residue counts are 50/48/115/31/23.
claims.inspected_location: mmCIF atom_site and pdbx_unobs_or_zero_occ_residues; count cross-check with entry API
claims.limits: Missing modeled metal is not absence of biochemical metal requirement; missing residues include construct/deposition discrepancies.

claims.claim: Page Methods specify NUDT5 1-210 while 5NWH/5NQR sequences cover 1-219; Balikci specifies 1-208 but 8RDZ deposits 1-219.
claims.inspected_location: Paper crystallography/protein Methods versus entity_poly and sequence mapping
claims.limits: Unresolved; no authors contacted or deposits changed.

claims.claim: Page assigns TH5427/TH1713 recognition to NUDT5 W28/W46 and E47/R51; Balikci assigns compound-9 recognition differently in NUDT14 (W34/Y17, D35, L107 environment).
claims.inspected_location: P structural Results/Figs.2-3; B Figs.3-4 and surrounding paragraph
claims.limits: No new contact-distance calculation; Arg51 selectivity explanation is a published proposal, not a causal result.

claims.inspected_location: Inspected Table 1 image and existing jm4c00072_si_002.csv
claims.limits: Already curated data; endpoint assays use different enzyme reaction times; no new external examples.

claims.claim: Compound 13: NUDT5 not active (>50 uM), NUDT14 3.72 +/-0.190 uM; 12 and 15 are not active against both at the reported threshold.
claims.inspected_location: Table 1 image, footnote b and existing CSV
claims.limits: Compound 13 is not established here as a selective cell-active NUDT14 probe.

claims.claim: 10-to-11 methyl deletion raises NUDT5 IC50 4.189-fold and NUDT14 IC50 1.973-fold. Compound-11 NUDT14 bias is nominally 3.931-fold; compound 13 nominally >13.44-fold.
claims.limits: No uncertainty propagation; ratios are not KD/Ki, confidence bounds, or proof of different poses.

claims.claim: TH5427 NUDT5 biochemical IC50 is 29 nM; NUDT14 inhibition was 38% at 100 uM.
claims.inspected_location: P TH5427 selectivity Results; SI Fig.9
claims.limits: No quantitative TH5427 NUDT14 dose-response IC50 verified here.

claims.claim: Compound 9 engages NUDT5 by NanoBRET EC50 1.08 +/-0.07 uM and BTK EC50 0.377 +/-0.062 uM; NUDT14 HiBiT-CETSA shift 5.5 +/-0.3 C after 30 uM for 1 h.
claims.inspected_location: B Fig.5 caption, cellular assay Methods
claims.limits: BTK interaction remains; NUDT14 thermal shift is not a cellular EC50 or proof of selective phenotype.

claims.claim: TH5427 at 1.5 uM inhibited hormone-associated nuclear ATP signal, H1 displacement, selected gene responses and progestin-driven proliferation in T47D experiments.
claims.limits: Context-specific cellular findings, not generic tumor killing, clinical efficacy, or separation from every possible off-target.

claims.claim: Balikci reports no significant protein-bound ADP-ribose change with compound 9 in the tested U2OS ARH3-KO model +/- PARG inhibition.
claims.inspected_location: B Results near Fig.5; SI Fig.S7 caption
claims.limits: Different context/readout from hormone-driven nuclear ATP; not evidence against all NUDT5/14 biology.

claims.claim: Differential Arg51-dependent recognition can guide NUDT5/NUDT14 selectivity and a chemical-genetic causal panel. Acute NUDT5 inhibition may be separable from protein loss.
claims.inspected_location: Proposed synthesis of verified structural and biological observations
claims.limits: Not experimentally tested; no docking, MD, degradation data, resistant mutants or clinical predictions generated.

claims.claim: NC5-02=ACT-19=Balikci compound 11; ACT-20=compound 10. Repaired dataset counts and reference-graph issue accepted as brief context.
claims.limits: No repository inspected; this is not an independent identity/dataset audit.

metadata.construct_caveat: Page Methods: NUDT5 1-210; deposited sequence Q9UKK9 1-219. Discrepancy not resolved; modeled maximum residue 208.
Page Methods: NUDT5 1-210; deposited sequence Q9UKK9 1-219. Discrepancy not resolved; modeled maximum residue 208.
Balikci Methods: NUDT5 1-208, cleaved N-terminal His/TEV tag; deposition instead records Q9UKK9 1-219. Discrepancy not resolved.
NUDT5 Q9UKK9 1-208 plus expression-tag Ser0; deposited entity length 209; author chains AAA/BBB map to label A/B.
NUDT14 O95848 1-222 plus expression-tag Ser0; deposited entity length 223; E. coli expressed, His/TEV tag removed in paper.
